title: Ecofriendly method for removal of cadmium ions and synthesis of cadmium oxide nanoparticles using a new generation of amine-functionalized cellulose
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38470-38493
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06257H, Paper
Open Access

Dina Hajjar, M. Mohery, Gamal M. A. Mahran
Amine-functionalized cellulose (CDAM) enables record cadmium adsorption (483.7 mg g−1) and recovery from real samples, followed by synthesis of crystalline CdO nanoparticles for sustainable remediation and resource valorization.
